summary: Explore & build the cute kitty city, create fun stories & discover surprises!
description:
Welcome to Little Kitty Town! Explore the cute city, create, and discover surprises and adventures on every corner! Build the town and create your own stories with the fluffy citizens of Little Kitty Town!

In Little Kitty Town kids can:
- Collect over 40 unique cats — from cute chubby kittens to panda cats and unicorn kitties! Cats can be picked up at the airport!
- Find hidden cat creatures - extraordinary surprises await!
- Mix and match clothes and accessories to create crazy cute pet outfits!
- Show off musical talent in the music shop!
- Harvest crops, go fishing and cook food!
- Wash, feed, and take care of the cats!
- Visit the car shop and get fun pet cars or boats to drive around in!
- Dance to the beat with the party cats!
- Clean up the city and keep it tidy!
- Freely interact with characters, locations, and objects!
- Create unique pet stories and discover endless possibilities!

Play Little Kitty Town — a cute pet game for kids that sparks curiosity, encourages creativity and opens the doors to the world of imagination!
